claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings, including PEEP 5 cmH2O and FiO2 40%, and monitor oxygenation and ventilation.
Perform arterial blood gas analysis to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation, given recent pH 7.32 and pCO2 46 mmHg.
Monitor serum potassium and correct hypokalemia, as recent potassium was 3.4 mEq/L.
Monitor ionized calcium and consider calcium replacement, as ionized calcium was 1.11 mmol/L.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit, which decreased from 13.1 g/dL to 10.2-10.4 g/dL.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR, PTT, fibrinogen) given INR 1.6 and fibrinogen 201 mg/dL.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy as indicated, with recent glucose 124-144 mg/dL.
Assess and manage pain, with recent pain level mild to moderate.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis and monitor for bleeding, given bed rest and coagulopathy.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium assessment, as patient is alert and calm with CAM-ICU negative.
